title: Philippines BPO Contact Center
thesis: Snowflake turns daily queue activity from a fictional Philippine BPO contact centre into service-level KPIs, 7-day service-level miss risk scores, abandonment rate anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on one governed platform.

talking_points: Service level attainment, service-level alerts, intervals below service level and agent labor cost in PHP for 48 fictional queues in Makati City, Taguig, Pasig City, Mandaue City, Cagayan de Oro and Baguio.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to queue-day rows.
The miss-driver chart shows which alerts end below service level and which never do, such as site power interruptions where traffic is rerouted.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of contact centre KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which queues should the real-time team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each queue's probability of at least one interval below service level in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags abandonment rate outliers per queue, and the forecast projects contact-centre-wide service-level alerts for 14 days to plan real-time cover.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Reforecast compliance, agent skill coverage and agents still in nesting frame the staffing gaps.
Reforecast compliance against missed intervals by queue shows where skipped intraday reforecasts and missed intervals move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, queue, miss-driver and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a caller abandons right now?

talking_points: Live contact events land in RAW.LIVE_INTERACTIONS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ABANDONED contacts with an SOP hint and the queue's current risk band, then emails the on-shift real-time analyst.
tabs.call_out: From abandoned contact to intraday action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 13 synthetic service-level recovery SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data for a fictional BPO contact centre, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
